description: This file defines the Goteo\Console\Console class which manages CLI command registration and execution for the Goteo application, including application setup, command management, and event dispatching.

classes.name: Console
classes.description: A static class providing methods to initialize, configure, and manage console commands and dispatcher for the Goteo application.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Initializes and returns the singleton instance of the console application.

methods.name: getConsoleDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the event dispatcher used by the console application.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a console command to the application.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an event via the console's event dispatcher.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Enables or returns the current debug mode status for the application.
